data.body_html:
The Starlite Festival 2034 is set to transform Marbella into a global hotspot for music, culture, and glamour. If you're planning to attend, a Puerto Banus boat rental offers an unforgettable way to elevate your evening. Imagine cruising the Mediterranean at sunset, sipping cava, and then stepping ashore for a world-class concert. This guide covers everything you need to know about combining a boat charter with your Starlite experience.

Why Choose a Boat Rental for Starlite Festival 2034?

Starlite Festival is held at the Auditorio Starlite in Nagüeles, just a short drive from Puerto Banus. A boat rental allows you to start your night with a relaxing sea voyage, avoiding traffic and adding a touch of luxury. With departures from Puerto Banus Marina, you can enjoy the coastline, spot La Concha mountain, and arrive at the venue refreshed. Plus, the included drinks and snacks mean you can pre-party on the water.

Our Fleet for Starlite Festival 2034

We offer a curated selection of boats, all departing from Puerto Banus. For small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are perfect at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Larger parties can opt for the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski.
